en.title: A real diagnosis, replayed.
en.body: This page replays an actual SAFA session: a home NAS that “got slower”, investigated end-to-end through the signed native Runtime. Every command below really ran against a registered resource; the Agent never saw an IP, a password, or a private key.
en.metaSanitized: Hostnames, aliases, and process names sanitized; measurements are verbatim.
en.boundaryTitle: The boundary: three requests the Runtime refused
en.boundaryBody: During the same session the Agent tried three things a normal SSH workflow would happily do. SAFA refused all of them — this is the whole point.
en.findingBody: Disk and CPU were fine. The real signal was swap: 10 GiB with 9.5 GiB (95%) in use while physical memory had ~7.3 GiB available.
en.conclusionBody: The NAS is not disk-full and not CPU-bound. The load it “feels” is the cost of paging: at some earlier point a memory spike (media transcode, containers, database, several sync/download services) pushed 95% of swap into use, and those pages were never reclaimed. Reads of swapped-out pages now go to disk.
conclusionPoints: Load 2.1 on a 12-core box — not CPU-bound.
Swap 95% used while RAM has headroom — historical memory spike, unreclaimed pages.
jellyfin and postgresql report inactive to systemd yet their processes run — they are managed by the NAS vendor stack / containers, so systemd state is not authoritative for them.
Nothing was restarted, deleted, or escalated. Only allow-listed read-only commands ran; credentials never left the Runtime.
en.nextBody: Confirm whether a large media-transcode or download batch ran recently. Container-level memory and logs need an additional reviewed read-only capability before the Agent can look at them.
en.replayHint: Replay this exact session on your own machine with the checked-in script.
en.finalLine: Credentials stayed on the Mac. The Agent only ever saw bounded, sanitized evidence.

authorizedFlow.title: Privileged actions: approve once, then execute
authorizedFlow.body: SAFA is not only about refusal. When the user grants an elevated action through the macOS authorization prompt (Touch ID), the same Broker executes it under the same bounded rules — without the Agent ever seeing the password.
authorizedFlow.status: User-presence approval is SAFA's current model: viewing protected details (resource show --details) already requires macOS authorization (Touch ID / password). Privileged execution follows the same approval path — in this preview sudo is refused; approved sudo with scoped grants ships next.

zh.title: 一次真实排查的完整回放。
zh.body: 本页回放一次真实的 SAFA 会话：一台“变慢了”的家庭 NAS，通过已签名的原生 Runtime 端到端排查。这里的每一条命令都真的在已登记资源上执行过；Agent 全程没有看到 IP、密码或私钥。
zh.metaSanitized: 主机名、别名与进程名已脱敏；所有数值为原始记录。
zh.boundaryTitle: 边界：三个被 Runtime 拒绝的请求
zh.boundaryBody: 同一会话里，Agent 尝试了三件普通 SSH 流程会照做不误的事，SAFA 全部拒绝——这正是它的意义。
zh.findingBody: 磁盘和 CPU 都正常。真正的信号是 swap：10 GiB 已用 9.5 GiB（95%），而物理内存还有约 7.3 GiB 可用。
zh.conclusionBody: NAS 磁盘没满、CPU 也没过载。它“感觉变慢”的代价来自换页：早前某个时刻的内存峰值（媒体转码、容器、数据库以及多个同步/下载服务）把 95% 的 swap 打满，之后换出页从未被回收，读取换出页时就要读盘。
conclusionPoints: 12 核机器 load 2.1——不是 CPU 瓶颈。
swap 已用 95% 而内存仍有富余——历史内存峰值留下的未回收换出页。
jellyfin 和 postgresql 在 systemd 视角为 inactive，但进程确实在跑——它们由 NAS 厂商栈/容器管理，systemd 状态对它们不具权威性。
没有重启、删除或提权任何东西。只执行了白名单内的只读命令；凭证从未离开 Runtime。
zh.nextBody: 确认近期是否跑过大批量媒体转码或下载任务。容器级内存与日志需要先评审并开放对应的只读能力，Agent 才能继续深入。
zh.replayHint: 想在这台机器上重放同一会话，请使用仓库中附带的回放脚本。
zh.finalLine: 凭证始终留在 Mac 上。Agent 只拿到了有限、经过脱敏的证据。

authorizedFlow.title: 高级操作：授权一次，然后执行
authorizedFlow.body: SAFA 不只是拦截。当用户通过 macOS 授权提示（Touch ID）批准一个提权操作时，同一个 Broker 会在同样的边界约束下执行它——Agent 依然看不到密码。
authorizedFlow.status: 用户在场授权是 SAFA 的现状：查看受保护详情（resource show --details）就需要 macOS 授权（Touch ID / 密码）。提权执行走同一个授权模型——预览版中 sudo 以拒绝守卫，带作用域授权的 sudo 将在下一版本交付。

steps.title: Agent 发起请求
steps.body: 在 nas.primary 上请求 sudo 命令，附上意图与预期影响。

steps.title: macOS 展示完整操作
steps.body: 目标资源、精确命令、意图与风险——这是 Agent 无法脚本化、重复触发或从对话里代答的提示。

steps.title: 用户用 Touch ID 授权
steps.body: 一次性授权，绑定到这条精确命令和资源版本。

steps.title: 有界执行，脱敏证据
steps.body: 凭证只在 Broker 边界内注入；Agent 拿到的仍然只有有限、脱敏的 TOON 结果。

interactive.requestCmd: safa exec nas.primary --intent "重启 jellyfin 媒体服务" -- sudo systemctl restart jellyfin
interactive.riskValue: 重启 jellyfin 媒体服务
interactive.scopeValue: 一次性授权 · 5 分钟内有效
interactive.sealed: sudo 密码始终留在 Broker 边界内。
interactive.touchId: 使用 Touch ID 授权
interactive.executing: 在同样的白名单策略下执行——凭证只在 Broker 内部注入。
interactive.resultNote: Agent 拿到的仍然只有有限、脱敏的 TOON 证据。sudo 密码不会出现在 argv、输出或审计记录里。

command: exec
status: completed
request_id: a1f0-4b2e-...

interactive.designNote: 这是 SAFA 现用于受保护操作（如查看资源详情）的授权模型——sudo 执行将沿用该模型，并在下一版本交付。

thinking.en: Before touching anything, verify the local Runtime is healthy. The launcher verifies the signed install, the lock file, and the Broker before any command runs.
thinking.zh: 动手前先确认本机 Runtime 正常。launcher 会先校验签名安装、锁文件和 Broker，任何一步不对都不会继续。

steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: doctor
status: completed
broker: ready
vault: ready

reading.en: Broker (policy + credential authority) and vault (encrypted resource directory) are both ready. Note what is not in this output: no endpoints, no credentials.
reading.zh: Broker（策略与凭证持有者）和 vault（加密资源目录）都已就绪。注意输出里没有任何端点或凭据信息。

thinking.en: I don't know this machine's alias in SAFA. List registered resources — I may only use an alias SAFA returns, never an IP.
thinking.zh: 我不知道这台机器在 SAFA 里的别名。先列出注册资源——只能使用 SAFA 返回的别名，绝不用 IP。

steps.output:

status: completed
count:

  returned: 11
  truncated: false
resources[11]{alias,kind,state,health}:

reading.zh: 共注册 11 个资源。nas.primary 就是 NAS。列表只暴露 4 个安全字段——没有 IP、用户名或密钥。

title.zh: 读取 nas.primary 安全摘要

thinking.en: Confirm what kind of resource this is and which capabilities it exposes before deciding how to investigate.
thinking.zh: 先确认资源类型和支持的能力，再决定怎么排查。

steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: resource.show

resource:

reading.zh: Linux 主机、健康、支持只读 exec，并且有 Docker。没有暴露任何连接细节。

title.zh: 拓扑：与哪些服务同站点

thinking.en: If the NAS misbehaves, who is affected? Ask the topology surface instead of asking the user to explain the network layout.
thinking.zh: 如果 NAS 出问题，会影响谁？直接查拓扑，而不是让用户解释网络布局。

steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: topology.show
status: completed
graph_revision: 56
task: placement
answer:
  outcome: found
  source: nas.primary
count:
  nodes: 6
  edges: 5
roots[1]: nas.primary
nodes[6]{alias,kind,resource_kind}:
  nas.primary,resource,host
  site.home,site,null
  data.home,resource,host
  desk.win,resource,host
  router.home,resource,host
  virt.host,resource,host
edges[5]{id,from,relation,to}:
  c150b9b0-...,nas.primary,located-in,site.home
  ...

reading.en: nas.primary sits in site.home with the router, virtualization host, database host, and a workstation. This is a placement answer — co-location, not a verified network path. SAFA keeps those distinct; the Agent must not invent a route.
reading.zh: nas.primary 位于 site.home，与路由器、虚拟化主机、数据库主机和一台工作站同站点。这是布局答案——只说明同站点，不是已验证的网络路径。SAFA 区分得很清楚，Agent 不能据此编造路由。

thinking.en: The user suspects a full disk. Check root capacity first. This is an allow-listed read-only command, so it runs automatically.
thinking.zh: 用户怀疑磁盘满。先看根分区容量。这是白名单内的只读命令，自动放行。

steps.command: ./scripts/safa exec nas.primary --intent "Check root filesystem capacity during a slowness report" -- df -h /
steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: exec
status: completed
request_id: d4f2c8e1-...
resource: nas.primary
intent: Check root filesystem capacity during a slowness report
execution:
  termination: exit
  remote_exit_code: 0
  stdout:
    content_type: text
    text: "Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on\n/dev/nvme0n1p3  9.6G  4.9G  4.2G  54% /\n"
    truncated: false
  stderr:
    content_type: text
    text: ""

reading.en: 54% used — not a full disk. Keep looking.

thinking.en: Disk is fine. Check CPU load next.
thinking.zh: 磁盘没问题。接着看 CPU 负载。

steps.command: ./scripts/safa exec nas.primary --intent "Check load average and uptime for a slowness report" -- uptime
steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: exec
status: completed
request_id: e9b1a7c3-...
execution:
  remote_exit_code: 0
  stdout.text: " 01:21:34 up 95 days, 13:48,  0 users,  load average: 2.10, 1.96, 2.07\n"

reading.en: 95 days uptime, load 2.1 on a 12-core machine — CPU is not the bottleneck either.
reading.zh: 开机 95 天，12 核机器 load 2.1——CPU 也不是瓶颈。

thinking.en: Disk and CPU are both fine. Memory and swap are the next suspect — “slowness” is often paging.
thinking.zh: 磁盘、CPU 都正常。下一个怀疑对象是内存和 swap——“变慢”经常是换页。

steps.command: ./scripts/safa exec nas.primary --intent "Check memory and swap pressure" -- free -h
steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: exec
status: completed
request_id: 4d1a202f-...
execution:
  remote_exit_code: 0
  stdout.text: "               total        used        free      shared  buff/cache   available\nMem:            15Gi       6.0Gi       745Mi       632Mi       8.3Gi       7.3Gi\nSwap:           10Gi       9.5Gi       1.0Gi\n"

reading.en: Swap: 10 GiB total, 9.5 GiB in use (95%) — while physical memory still has ~7.3 GiB available. The system hit a memory spike at some earlier point and the swapped-out pages were never reclaimed. Reading those pages back means hitting disk: the classic “gets slower over time” pattern.
reading.zh: swap 10 GiB 已用 9.5 GiB（95%），而物理内存还有约 7.3 GiB 可用。说明系统早前经历过内存峰值，换出页一直没被回收。访问换出页就要读盘——这正是“越用越卡”的典型特征。

title.en: Who holds memory: no live hotspot
title.zh: 内存占用者：当前没有热点

thinking.en: Confirm whether swap pressure is still growing or is residue from an earlier spike.
thinking.zh: 确认 swap 压力是还在增长，还是早前峰值留下的残留。

steps.command: ./scripts/safa exec nas.primary --intent "Find which processes hold the most memory to explain swap usage" -- ps -eo pid,ppid,user,stat,comm,%cpu,%mem --sort=-%mem
steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: exec
status: completed
request_id: 0b4a1c6e-...
execution:
  remote_exit_code: 0
  stdout.text: "    PID    PPID USER     STAT COMMAND         %CPU %MEM
 644549   12425 postgres Ss   postgres           0.2  1.6
1627628       1 root     Sl   nas-app-02         1.0  1.3
1636647 1636628 root     Ssl+ jellyfin          0.0  0.9
 798175       1 root     Ssl  antivirus-scan     0.2  0.7
3035257 3035218 root     Ssl  uptime-kuma        0.6  0.7
3809693 3809673 ...     Ssl  nextcloud          0.0  0.6
  12317       1 root     Ssl  nas-app-03         0.1  0.6
  13057       1 root     Ssl  dockerd            0.5  0.5
 493080       1 root     S<sl zfs-v3             1.0  0.5
  ...
"

reading.en: No single process is large (top is postgres at 1.6%). Current memory use is low — consistent with unreclaimed swap residue, not a live leak. This NAS runs a large resident service set: vendor apps, jellyfin, nextcloud, postgres, mariadb, sync and download clients, media transcode.
reading.zh: 单个进程都不大（最高 postgres 1.6%）。当前内存使用很低——与“未回收的换出页残留”一致，而不是正在泄漏。这台 NAS 常驻服务非常多：厂商应用、Jellyfin、Nextcloud、Postgres、MariaDB、同步与下载客户端、媒体转码。

title.zh: 服务状态：一个真实的矛盾

thinking.en: Is a specific service actually down? Check with the allow-listed systemd state query.
thinking.zh: 某个服务是不是真的挂了？用白名单内的 systemd 状态查询确认。

steps.command: ./scripts/safa exec nas.primary --intent "Verify whether the jellyfin media service is running" -- systemctl is-active jellyfin
steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: exec
status: remote_execution_failed
request_id: d8587949-...
execution:
  termination: exit
  remote_exit_code: 3
  stdout.text: "inactive\n"
  stderr: ""

reading.en: systemd says inactive (exit 3) — yet the ps output above shows a jellyfin process. The same is true for postgresql. These services are not managed by systemd (vendor stack / containers), so systemd state is not authoritative for them. I will report the contradiction instead of concluding the service is down.
reading.zh: systemd 报告 inactive（exit 3）——但上面的 ps 里明明有 jellyfin 进程。postgresql 同理。这些服务不受 systemd 管理（厂商栈/容器），systemd 状态对它们不具权威性。我会如实报告这个矛盾，而不是下“服务挂了”的结论。

title.zh: 服务状态：postgresql 同样如此

thinking.en: Check the database service the same way to confirm the pattern.
thinking.zh: 用同样方式确认数据库服务，验证这个模式。

steps.command: ./scripts/safa exec nas.primary --intent "Verify whether the postgresql database service is running" -- systemctl is-active postgresql
steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: exec
status: remote_execution_failed
request_id: 7370ff23-...
execution:
  termination: exit
  remote_exit_code: 3
  stdout.text: "inactive\n"
  stderr: ""

reading.en: Same pattern: inactive to systemd, process alive. systemd is simply not the manager for these units on this NAS.
reading.zh: 同样的模式：systemd 视角 inactive，但进程在跑。systemd 并不是这些单元的管理者。

thinking.en: A normal SSH session could try to restart the service with sudo. SAFA has no sudo path in this MVP — it must refuse, and it does.
thinking.zh: 普通 SSH 会话可以直接 sudo 重启服务。当前 MVP 没有 sudo 能力——SAFA 必须拒绝，它也确实是这么做的。

steps.command: ./scripts/safa exec nas.primary --intent "Restart the jellyfin service with elevated rights" -- sudo systemctl restart jellyfin
steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: exec
status: failed
error:
  code: approval_not_in_mvp
  message: The diagnostic MVP permits only bounded read-only commands.
  retryable: false

title.zh: 边界：白名单外命令被拒绝

thinking.en: Reading logs is a normal diagnostic, but journalctl is not in the allow-list. “Looks like a log read” is not a reason to allow it.
thinking.zh: 看日志是常规排查，但 journalctl 不在白名单里。“看起来像读日志”不能成为放行的理由。

steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: exec
status: failed
error:
  code: approval_not_in_mvp
  message: The diagnostic MVP permits only bounded read-only commands.
  retryable: false

reading.en: The allow-list is exact matching with no gray zone: even a docker ps format string one character off is refused. That is a feature, not a bug.
reading.zh: 白名单是精确匹配，没有灰色地带：连 docker ps 的格式差一个字符都会被拒。这是特性，不是缺陷。

title.zh: 边界：未注册资源被拒绝

thinking.en: Try to target a machine that is not registered. The Agent must not be able to point SAFA at arbitrary infrastructure.
thinking.zh: 尝试指定一台未注册的机器。Agent 不能把 SAFA 指向任意基础设施。

steps.command: ./scripts/safa exec not-registered-alias --intent "Check production disk capacity" -- df -h /
steps.output:
schema: dev.safa.cli/v2
command: exec
status: failed
error:
  code: resource_not_found
  message: The requested resource is not registered.
  retryable: false
